rubric.role_summary: Founding, hands-on B2B marketing lead for an AI robotics manufacturing company, owning brand and product marketing, the website, channels, events, and demand generation.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Founding, hands-on B2B marketing lead for an AI robotics manufacturing company, owning brand and product marketing, the website, channels, events, and demand generation.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 6+ years in B2B marketing.
- Brand and product marketing experience.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Marketing experience in hardware, robotics, industrial automation, or deep tech.
- Familiarity with defense or government-adjacent buyers.
- Fluency with HubSpot, Marketo, or Salesforce.
- Enough Figma proficiency to communicate a concept.
- Experience managing a junior marketer or contractor.
- 6+ years in B2B marketing, including hands-on execution rather than only directing work.
- Owned brand and product marketing, including positioning and messaging for a sales team.
- Managed external agencies in web, PR, creative, or events.
- Ran a website project end to end with a design or development partner.
- Hands-on events experience covering booth planning, working the show, and lead follow-up.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
